item.title: Democrats and White House trade offers as shutdown of Homeland Security looms
item.description: WASHINGTON — Democrats have begun tentative talks with the White House on their demands for “dramatic” new restrictions on President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown, trading offers just days before funding for the Department of Homeland Security is set to expire.

item.title: ZoomInfo reports Q4 earnings of $34.7M
item.description: VANCOUVER — ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. (GTM) on Monday reported fourth-quarter earnings of $34.7 million.

item.title: U.S. moves to wipe out Stephen Bannon contempt of Congress case
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Justice Department took steps Monday to unwind the contempt of Congress case against Stephen Bannon, who already served four months in prison for a conviction that he has appealed to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Fort Vancouver basketball on the rise as postseason begins
item.description: For the first time since the 2007-08 season, Fort Vancouver’s boys and girls basketball teams are navigating the playoffs together and creating a basketball buzz that hasn’t been this loud in nearly two decades.

item.title: Trump threatens to block Gordie Howe International Bridge between Detroit and Canada from opening
item.description: LANSING, Mich. — President Donald Trump threatened Monday evening to prevent the new Gordie Howe International Bridge between Detroit and Windsor from opening until Canada treats the United States with, what he described as, "fairness and respect."

item.title: Columbia River freshman Mila Davis wins 1A/2A state girls bowling title
item.description: Columbia River freshman Mila Davis edged out R.A. Long freshman Zoey Jason by 14 pins to win the 1A/2A girls bowling state title on Monday at Bowlero in Tukwila.

item.title: Raiders officially hire Klint Kubiak as head coach after his Super Bowl win with Seahawks
item.description: The Las Vegas Raiders announced Klint Kubiak as their head coach. Kubiak arrives fresh from a Super Bowl victory with the Seattle Seahawks. He faces key decisions, including hiring offensive and defensive coordinators.

item.title: Camara’s career night leads Blazers in rout of Sixers, 135-118
item.description: Toumani Camara scored a career-high 30 points, leading the Portland Trail Blazers to a 135-118 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers.
